video_caption: The video opens with a white background displaying an animated logo for "FLOAT CONFERENCE PORTLAND 2016", featuring a stylized "O" with a blue line through it, followed by the website "floatconference.com". It then transitions to a wide shot of a stage set up with four white pod-like structures, two on each side, illuminated by blue stage lighting. A large screen at the back displays a title slide that reads "Floatation for Service-Induced Stress: A Veteran's Story," with a "WEED WARRIOR" logo and a dedication to "Lance Corporal Jared MacKinney KIA 24 August 2010" at the bottom. Two individuals, identified by screen overlays as Bek Houghton and Michael Harding, stand at a modern, blue and black podium in the center of the stage. Bek Houghton, with light brown hair in a ponytail and wearing glasses and a dark patterned top, listens attentively to Michael Harding, who has long, curly brown hair, a beard, and wears a light grey t-shirt with a "WEED WARRIOR" logo, jeans, and a brown belt. Michael is actively speaking into a microphone and gesturing with his hands, sharing his story with a passionate and engaging demeanor, while Bek occasionally smiles or glances at the audience. The background behind them features white, geometrically textured panels, including a "Flower of Life" symbol on a circular panel to the left, all bathed in a vivid blue light.

The video segment opens with a man and a woman standing on a stage behind a modern, blue-and-brown podium. The man, with long, wavy brown hair, a beard, and wearing a light grey t-shirt with a graphic and blue jeans, is speaking into a microphone. The woman, with reddish-brown hair pulled back and glasses, wearing a dark blue top, stands to his left, smiling faintly. Behind them is a white wall with a raised geometric pattern, illuminated by blue stage lights on the sides. At 00:03, the shot widens to include a large projection screen behind them. The screen displays the title "Floatation for Service-Induced Stress: A Veteran's Story" with a logo beneath it that reads "TWISTED WARRIOR" (featuring a cannabis leaf). Below the logo, it says, "In memory of Lance Corporal Jared MacKinney KIA 24 August 2010". The man continues to speak, gesturing slightly with his hands. At 00:05, the screen content changes. The title "Afghanistan 2010 – Mentoring Task Force 1" appears at the top, above a wide photo of approximately 40-50 soldiers in camouflage uniforms posing for a group picture outdoors, with a military vehicle in the background. The man continues to speak, referencing his experiences. At 00:15, the screen updates again to display a collage of four images, still under the title "Afghanistan 2010 – Mentoring Task Force 1". The top-left image shows a vast mountainous landscape with a valley, the top-right shows two soldiers in combat gear, one firing a machine gun, amidst dust. The bottom-left depicts two soldiers sitting by a stream with lush greenery, and the bottom-right shows a vibrant sunset over a body of water with distant mountains. The man maintains eye contact with the audience while speaking.

The video opens on a stage illuminated with blue lighting, where a woman in a dark dress and a man in a t-shirt stand near a small, multi-colored triangular object. To their left is a grey, rectangular structure with a door, and to their right are two white, rounded pod-like structures, with stacks of green boxes placed between them. A large screen behind them initially displays the title "Afghanistan 2010 - Mentoring Task Force 1" with a collage of four images: mountains, a soldier in a cockpit, two soldiers on the ground, and a sunset over a landscape. As the scene progresses, the screen transitions to display a new title, "From fit and healthy in 2009... ...to Zombie-fried in 2011," alongside two side-by-side photographs: the left photo shows the man from the stage, looking younger and fitter in a camouflage uniform, alongside a smiling woman with glasses, while the right photo shows the same man, looking heavier and somewhat paler in a suit, with the same woman, also smiling, in a floral dress.

The video begins with a slide displaying two framed photographs. The top-left photo shows a man with short brown hair wearing a military camouflage uniform, smiling next to a woman with long dark hair and glasses who is also smiling. Above this photo, text reads "From fit and healthy in 2009...". The bottom-right photo shows the same man, now noticeably heavier, wearing a dark suit and a striped tie, standing next to the same woman, who also appears heavier, wearing a black and floral dress, glasses, and a pink hair accessory. Text below this photo reads "...to Zombie-fried in 2011". The scene then transitions to a medium shot of a man with long, wavy brown hair, pulled back, speaking into a lapel microphone clipped to his grey t-shirt. The t-shirt features a graphic of cannabis leaves arranged in a circular pattern with the words "WEEDED WARRIOR" printed below. He has a serious expression and is looking slightly to his right, against a bright blue background.

A man with long, curly, light brown hair, pulled back into a half-ponytail, wearing a grey t-shirt with a graphic of cannabis leaves forming a circle around the text "WEEDED WARRIOR" is speaking into a lapel microphone against a blue background. He has tattoos on his arms, including a prominent snake-like design on his right arm. Initially shown in a close-up, he appears serious, making hand gestures as he speaks. The scene transitions to a wider shot, revealing he is standing at a blue and black podium alongside a woman with long brown hair and glasses, who is standing attentively beside him. Behind them, a large screen displays two framed photos: the left photo shows the man in a camouflage army uniform with the woman, smiling, captioned "From fit and healthy in 2009..."; the right photo shows them in formal attire, looking less vibrant, with the caption "...to Zombie-fied in 2011". The background consists of blue draped fabric and a white textured wall. The man continues to speak, using expressive hand gestures, while the woman occasionally adjusts her glasses, observing him.

In the video segment, a man with long, wavy brown hair, wearing a gray t-shirt with a "Canna Warrior" graphic, blue jeans, and a brown belt, stands to the right of a black and blue podium, speaking and gesturing with a small black remote. A woman with long brown hair in a ponytail, glasses with light blue frames, and a dark blue patterned top, stands behind the podium, listening intently. The background is a white wall with a geometric pattern, illuminated by blue light. The scene then widens to show a stage with two white, pod-like structures and a rectangular white object, possibly float tanks or similar therapeutic equipment, surrounded by stacks of green-labeled bottles. A large screen behind them displays a slide with text reading "From fit and healthy in 2009..." and "...to Zombie-fried in 2011." The slide presents two photographs: the left photo shows a healthy-looking man in a camouflage uniform and a smiling woman in glasses; the right photo shows the same man appearing gaunt in a suit and tie, next to the same woman who now appears heavier and wears a floral top. The video then cuts back to a close-up of the woman speaking, her expression serious and animated with hand gestures, with the man's arm visible next to her.

A woman with reddish-brown hair tied in a ponytail, wearing glasses with teal frames and a dark blue patterned top, speaks animatedly on a stage with a blue background. She gestures with her hands as she talks, with part of a man in a grey t-shirt visible beside her. The scene then transitions to a wider shot of the stage, revealing a large screen behind the speakers. The screen initially displays two photos of a couple, captioned "From fit and healthy in 2009" and "to Zombie-fied in 2011," showing a man in military fatigues embracing a woman, and then both of them in formal wear. The screen then changes to a Google search page, with "Google Australia" at the top and "Alternative treatments for post traumatic stress" typed into the search bar. The camera returns to a close-up of the woman speaking with passionate expressions and hand gestures. The view widens again, showing the full stage adorned with a white, box-like structure on the left, several stacks of white boxes, and two white, egg-shaped pods on the right, while the Google search screen remains visible. Finally, the screen behind the speakers displays a presentation slide titled "Journey to Wellness" with bullet points: "nutrition and lifestyle," "medicinal cannabis and the endocannabinoid system," "yoga, meditation and mindfulness," "peer to mentor support programs," and "floatation therapy," accompanied by a photo of the same couple smiling in front of a colorful wall, as the woman continues to speak.

At the 00:01 mark, a woman with light brown hair, glasses, and a dark blue top stands behind a multi-toned blue and black podium, looking down at notes and gesturing with her hands as she speaks. To her right, a man with long, wavy brown hair, a beard, and visible arm tattoos stands beside the podium. He wears a light grey t-shirt featuring a graphic of a military helmet adorned with cannabis leaves, and the text "CANNABIS WARRIOR" (CANNABIS WARRIOR). He is also wearing blue jeans and a brown belt, holding a small dark object in his right hand, and is looking towards the woman with a neutral expression. The background consists of a large white wall with intricate geometric patterns, including a circular "Flower of Life" design on the left, transitioning into a blue-lit stage background on the right.

In this video segment, a woman with fair skin, reddish-brown hair tied in a ponytail, and teal-rimmed glasses is speaking into a microphone. She wears a dark blue patterned dress and is very animated, using hand gestures and expressive facial movements as she talks about "the most important points," "personal health and wellbeing," and "multiple modalities" including "cannabis and floatation." A man with long, wavy brown hair, a beard, a grey t-shirt with a graphic, and blue jeans is visible to her right. He has tattoos on his arms and holds a small black object. The background is a bright blue with abstract, illuminated shapes. At one point, the camera shows a wider view of the stage, revealing the woman standing behind a dark and light blue podium, still gesturing, while the man stands slightly behind her. He then steps forward as she gestures towards a large screen displaying a presentation titled "Floatation for Service-Induced Stress." The bullet points on the screen read: "Embracing responsibility for personal health and wellness," "Combining modalities," and "Floatation for trauma management." An image of a floatation tank is displayed on the screen, with "Photo Credit: Kym Mellon - The Ripple Effect of PTSD" below it.

The video opens with a white slide displaying the title "Floatation for Service-Induced Stress." Below the title are three bullet points: "Embracing responsibility for personal health and wellness," "Combining modalities," and "Floatation for trauma management." To the right of the text is a rectangular image of a woman with her back to the camera, inside a flotation tank glowing with blue light. A photo credit at the bottom reads "Photo credit: Kym Melzer - The Ripple Effect of PTSD." At 0:10, the scene transitions to a medium shot of a man with long, wavy brown hair tied back, wearing a light grey t-shirt with a graphic design. He is speaking, looking towards the right side of the frame, with a small microphone attached to his collar. The background is a solid blue, out of focus. He speaks expressively, using hand gestures. At 0:32, the shot widens to show the man standing at a podium with a woman to his left. The man, still wearing the grey t-shirt and jeans, gestures with his hands as he speaks. The woman, with reddish-brown hair pulled back and wearing glasses and a blue top, stands behind the podium, looking at the man with a slight smile. The podium itself has a dark top with blue and dark brown geometric patterns on its front. The background features a textured white wall with a circular geometric pattern on the left, transitioning to a bright blue wall on the right.

A man with shoulder-length curly brown hair, wearing a gray t-shirt with a subtle graphic on it and a lapel microphone, speaks intently against a vibrant blue background, maintaining a serious and focused expression. At 0:31, the scene transitions to a wider shot of a stage where the man stands to the right of a woman in a dark top. They are positioned in front of a large screen displaying a presentation slide titled "Floatation for Service-Induced Stress" with bullet points: "Embracing responsibility for personal health and wellness," "Combining modalities," and "Floatation for trauma management," accompanied by an image of a blue floatation tank. On the stage are various white, sleek floatation pods and stacks of bottled water. The video then cuts back to a close-up of the man as he continues to speak, occasionally gesturing with his hands, his expression remaining earnest and thoughtful.

The video begins with a white screen displaying the black "WEEDED WARRIOR" logo, which includes a cannabis leaf above the text, and contact information: "Find us at: weededwarrior.com, facebook/weededwarrior, mick@weededwarrior.com | bek@weededwarrior.com". A man with long, curly brown hair, wearing a grey t-shirt with a graphic of a military helmet and cannabis leaf, stands on a stage next to a woman with auburn hair and glasses. The man is speaking, gesturing with his hands, while the woman stands behind a blue and black podium, smiling at him. The background is a white wall with a geometric pattern and blue lighting. A close-up shot focuses on the man's face as he continues to speak, his expression serious. The camera then widens to show the entire stage, featuring three float tanks (one rectangular, two pod-shaped) and stacks of white bags, likely Epsom salts. The "Weeded Warrior" logo and contact details are projected on a large screen behind them. The audience in the dimly lit auditorium is seen applauding. Finally, the man and woman walk off stage, and the screen transitions to the "FLOAT CONFERENCE PORTLAND 2016" logo and the website "floatconference.com".
